generate_topsort_dataset: generate a synthetic topological sort dataset sample with N vocabulary size for pretraining
generate_multi_token_words: generate a list of multi-token words with configurable vocabulary size and token length range
generate_dag: build a random directed acyclic graph with degree constraints using TopoSortDepthStats
parse_tokens: validate and parse a topological sort token sequence to extract query and answer
parse_tokens_multi: parse multi-token word sequences and validate topological order correctness
